title: AddOpening Command
description: Cut a door or window opening into a vertical Forsk wall and add an A-OPEN marker. Host omitted uses the current selection (exactly one wall).

host_id.description: Host wall GUID. Omit to use the current selection.

width.description: Opening width in mm. Default 900 door / 1200 window.

sill.description: Opening bottom Z. Default 0 door / 900 window.

t.description: Placement along the chosen facade segment, 0–1. Exclusive with distance_mm. Default 0.5.

distance_mm.description: Distance in mm from segment start. Exclusive with t.
